translation: Took place in posad Serock, 25 July 1890, 10 AM. Appeared personally Berek Koltun, laborer, 65, and Szymla Markus, shoemaker, 34, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 6 PM in posad Serock died Frajda Jarzombek[?], aged two years, daughter of Moszek and Dwojra nee Kran[?]. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Frajda Jarzombek, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us. The witnesses are illiterate.
